quiz_title: Computational Thinking · Quiz 1 · 2023 July · Foundation AN2 · Part 1
subject: Computational Thinking

prompt.value: The following pseudocode is executed using the "Words" dataset. What will count represent at the end of the execution?

options.value: Number of words which are adjectives and have at least two letters
Number of words which are either adjectives or have at most two letters but not both
Number of words which are adjectives or have at most two letters or both
Number of words which are not adjectives and have exactly two letters

explanation.value: flag is set True if the word is an Adjective OR has at most 2 letters (two independent ifs ⇒  inclusive OR). So count is the number of words that are adjectives, or have at most two letters, or both.

prompt.value: The following pseudocode is executed using the "Library" dataset. What will A represent at the end of the execution?

options.value: Number of books written by author Kalam in English
Number of books not written by author Kalam in English
Number of English books written by authors other than Kalam
Number of books that are written by Kalam or in English or both

explanation.value: Inside the loop A counts books that are neither by Kalam nor in English. count is the total number of books, so the final A = count − A = total − (not-Kalam ∧  not-English) = the number of books written by Kalam OR in English (or both).

prompt.value: The given pseudocode is executed using the "Words" dataset. Assume vCount(X) returns the number of vowels in X.Word. What will B represent at the end of the execution?

options.value: Average letter count of words in the dataset
Sum of words that contain at least two vowels
Average letter count of words containing at least two vowels in the dataset
Average letter count of words containing at most two vowels in the dataset

explanation.value: Only words with vCount(X) > 1 (i.e. at least two vowels) contribute their LetterCount to SumT and increment CountT. B = SumT / CountT is therefore the average letter count of words containing at least two vowels.

prompt.value: Consider the "Scores" dataset. What will C represent at the end of the execution?

options.value: Sum of Total marks of students whose Physics marks are less than the average Physics marks
Sum of Total marks of students whose Physics marks are more than the average Physics marks
Sum of Physics marks of students whose Physics marks are more than the average Physics marks
Sum of Physics marks of students whose Physics marks are less than the average Physics marks

explanation.value: DoSomething returns A, the average Physics marks. The main loop then adds X.Total (total marks) for every student whose Physics marks exceed A, so C is the sum of Total marks of students whose Physics marks are more than the average Physics marks.

prompt.value: The following pseudocode is executed using the "Words" dataset. What will A represent at the end of the execution?

options.value: Number of words with at most two vowels
Number of words with at least three vowels
Number of words with at least two vowels
Number of words with exactly two vowels

explanation.value: The inner loop counts the vowels of each word in B. A is incremented when B > 2, i.e. the word has at least three vowels.

prompt.value: Consider the Player dataset below, which keeps track of the runs scored by each player. A player can join a sports club if his runs are above 75 in Trial, TestSeries and WorldCup. A, B and C store the number of players in the GoldStriker, SilverStriker and BronzeStriker clubs respectively, based on the pseudocode. Which club will be allotted to a player who scored 167, 180, 180 runs in Trial, TestSeries and WorldCup respectively? It is a Multiple Select Question.

PlayerID Name Trial TestSeries WorldCup 1 Virat Kohli 167 186 104 2 MS Dhoni 177 184 123 3 Harbhajan Singh 89 74 93 4 Gautam Gambhir 100 100 100 … … … … … 99 Qureshi Ahmed 22 134 130 PlayerID Name Trial TestSeries WorldCup 100 Afzal Khan 130 130 130

options.value: GoldStriker
SilverStriker
BronzeStriker
SilverStriker and BronzeStriker

explanation.value: Runs 167, 180, 180 are all above 75, so the player is eligible. maxMatch: Trial(167) is not greater than TestSeries(180) → else branch; TestSeries(180) is not greater than WorldCup(180) → returns "WorldCup". match == "WorldCup" increments A, the GoldStriker club, so the player is allotted GoldStriker.
